cancel.comment: Dialog dismiss button — cancels the action and closes the dialog.

ok.comment: Generic confirm button on an informational result dialog (acknowledge / dismiss); iOS reuses it for the custom-theme cap-reached alert.

delete.comment: Generic delete action label / a11y description (custom-theme card menu item, dictionary row delete).

error.comment: Generic error alert title (iOS backup/restore + import/export failure alerts; the alert body is localized separately). iOS-only: the Android failure surfaces are toasts that already use their own i18n keys.

info.comment: Info / help button a11y contentDescription (settings inline info-popover trigger). Android-only: iOS uses an empty-title alert whose body carries the text.

close.comment: Close button a11y contentDescription (color-picker dialog dismiss). Android-only: the iOS color picker uses the system dismiss affordance.

back.comment: Back-navigation a11y contentDescription for the TopAppBar navigationIcon on Android host sub-screens. Android-only: iOS uses the system NavigationStack back button (OS-locale, not overridable to the in-app picker). Custom in-app nav controls — including the main-app tab titles (i18n_nav_tab*) — follow the display-language picker; only the OS-provided system back affordance stays on the OS locale.

viewWebsite.comment: Link button opening an official website in the browser (data sources + the app's own site).

exportFailed.comment: Error message shown when exporting user dictionary data fails.

values.ja: エクスポートに失敗しました

importFailed.comment: Error message shown when importing user dictionary data fails (incl. unreadable / non-UTF-8 file on both platforms).

values.ja: インポートに失敗しました
